description: This file defines a React functional component 'NoteEditor' that provides a user interface for editing, creating, and deleting notes. It manages input state and handles form submissions and delete actions through provided callback functions.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Handles form submission for saving a note, manages saving state, and calls the onSubmit callback with the note's title and content.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a note, with confirmation prompt and manages deleting state before calling the onDelete callback.
